page.overview:
What is Ursula Flint?

Ursula Black (née Flint) (fl. 1877–1889) was a British pure-blood witch and a member of the Flint family.

Ursula married Phineas Nigellus Black, the Headmaster of Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry during his time. The couple had five children: Sirius, Phineas, Arcturus, Belvina, and Cygnus. She was an ancestress of many pure-blood witches and wizards in Great Britain.

The name Ursula means "little bear", derived from the Latin word ursa, "she-bear", which gives its name to associated with the Greek myth of Callisto, a nymph who was turned into a bear. Saint Ursula was a legendary Roman-British princess who was martyred by the Huns while returning from a pilgrimage in the fourth century.
